## Type of Change
- [ ] New Skill
- [ ] Bug Fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Improvement (non-breaking change which improves a skill or validator)

## Governance Checklist

- [ ] I have added/updated tests in `skills/skill-governance/tests/`.
- [ ] I have included a governance artifact if this is a governed change.
